_about: One release entry in the release format, written by scripts/release-runs.py from real runs of two builds. The commands, output lines, exit codes, result files and builds come from the raw record in site/changelog/logs/; whole lines are cut to fit by the fixture, no line is edited. Only label, headline, lead, next.note and film are written by hand. Whether the release is tagged, and its date, come from git when the site is built.
label: Behavior change
headline: unpack now cleans up after an extraction that was stopped

lead.text: An extraction that is killed part way leaves a hidden folder beside the archive, with the files it wrote so far. The next

in 0.5.5 removes that folder, says so, and then extracts. It removes the folder only when its lock file proves unpack made it and no extraction still holds it. Version 0.5.4 extracted the same archive and left the hidden folder where it was.

output: unpack: removed ./.photos.unpack-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.partial, a folder left by an interrupted extraction.

note.text: Both versions exit with code 0. To see what an archive holds without writing anything, run

runs_note: Each ran the same commands on a fresh copy of one synthetic archive, photos.zip: a zip archive of 3 photos, and beside it the hidden folder that an extraction stopped part way leaves behind. Output is shortened to fit by cutting whole lines. Every command ran in a sandbox that let it write only inside its scratch folder and could not run /usr/bin/security.
